audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Finite-height first-order localization without compact support; Missing acceleration term in fixed-velocity transport hierarchy; Unsmeared singularities and logarithmic cell energy in local renormalization
limitations: Finite-height first-order localization without compact support — Counterevidence: Compactly supported v or nonnegative-only mu would exclude this example. The theorem explicitly permits signed mu. Full vertical integration avoids this finite-height counterexample.

Missing acceleration term in fixed-velocity transport hierarchy — Counterevidence: A time-dependent Eulerian velocity v_t=v composed with (I+t v)^-1 gives a different possible hierarchy. The source explicitly fixes v in A.6. Section 4 has a separate PDE route.

Unsmeared singularities and logarithmic cell energy in local renormalization — Counterevidence: The needed local cell norm can remain bounded; the proof replaces it by a global norm. The global Section 5.4 estimate uses a different Term 2 bound. Signed backgrounds create further total-variation issues, but the two counterexamples do not depend on signed backgrounds.

Nonmonotone mesoscale truncation path — Counterevidence: The selected pair sum in (2.40) may be empty for this proof-step counterexample, so it does not refute the proposition's final estimate. The derivative sign issue alone is repairable with a constant.

Undefined indices and unrecovered high-order derivative budget — Counterevidence: A sharper local regularity proof could improve the derivative count; the sequence is not a counterexample to the best possible corrected final estimate. The empty product is at p=n, not the printed p=0.

False uniform amplitude dependence in Corollary 1.3, with local norm-power subfindings — Counterevidence: The consistent unsquared estimate (3.17) supports a local correction. Allowing the constant to depend on M changes the uniform corollary.
False uniform amplitude dependence in Corollary 1.3, with local norm-power subfindings — Counterevidence: Consistent unsquared estimate (3.17) and its use preserve the separate first-order argument.

Missing diagonal self-interaction term — Counterevidence: The missing terms obey C||grad v||^n/(N^2 eta_i^s) per particle; the logarithmic case is directly controlled by the density error. Thus the equality's failure does not imply failure of the final estimate.

Moment-cancelling mollifier construction has a nonzero second moment — Counterevidence: Centered symmetric bumps avoid this second-order cross term. A Taylor quotient construction works at every order.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Finite-height first-order localization without compact support

d=1,s=0,N=2; fixed smooth bounded v with plateaus -1,0,+1 and compactly supported derivative; Omega=[-3,3], ell=3; particles R+-1/4, R>10; mu=p_R+q_j has mass one, global and local Linfinity norm 8, compact support and finite absolute logarithmic energy; lambda=1/16; #I_Omega=0; r_i=1/64.

Recorded check: Missing acceleration term in fixed-velocity transport hierarchy

d=3,s=1,k=0; smooth compact v equals x near e1; a real annular-Fourier Schwartz potential h has partial_1 h(e1)=-2; f=-Delta h/(4pi) is zero-mean Schwartz with Fourier support away from zero. A separate radial-bump illustration checks exact scalar derivatives.

Recorded check: Unsmeared singularities and logarithmic cell energy in local renormalization

Example A: d=1,s=0,N=2, mu=1_{[-1/2,1/2]}, particles 0,4, v supported [-1,1], Omega'=[-3,3], Omega=[-18,18], ell=3, lambda=1/2. Example B: d=2,s=0,N=2, particles 0,e1, mu_R=nu0/4+nu_Re1/4+nu_3Re1/2 with uniform disks radius 1/10, R>50; Omega and Omega' are closed balls; local density and radii fixed; genuine radial moment-cancelling mollifier; cell radius 2R has mass 1/2. Both backgrounds are nonnegative.

Recorded check: Nonmonotone mesoscale truncation path

d=3,s=1,N=2; Omega upper half-space; particles at (0,0,3lambda) and (3lambda,0,3lambda); 0<lambda<1; bounded probability background far from the particle balls within Omega with height 1/(2lambda^3); radii path lambda,2lambda,lambda/4.

Recorded check: Undefined indices and unrecovered high-order derivative budget

n>=2; fixed compact support, fixed admissible lambda and ell; smooth approximating fields v_J=v0+J^(-2n) chi sin(Jx), with nonzero v0'' on the cutoff plateau.

Recorded check: False uniform amplitude dependence in Corollary 1.3, with local norm-power subfindings

d=1,s=0,N=2; mu=1 on [-1/2,1/2]; particles +-1/4; compact v_A=A v0, v0=x on [-2,2] and supported [-4,4]; ell=6, Omega'=B6, Omega=B36, lambda=1/2.

Recorded check: Missing diagonal self-interaction term

Use the P06 compact affine logarithmic example with n=2,A=1 and unit-mass, possibly signed, mollifiers with the prescribed small supports.

Recorded check: Moment-cancelling mollifier construction has a nonzero second moment

d=1,m=2; Fourier convention exp(-i xi x); psi,zeta are smooth compact unit-mass bumps with first moments A,B, e.g. translates by 1 of centered even probability bumps.
